random_sampling: randomly sample N points from a point cloud numpy array with optional replacement
point_cloud_to_volume: convert an Nx3 point cloud into a 3D occupancy grid volume of given voxel size
point_cloud_to_bbox: extract an axis-aligned bounding box center and dimensions from a point cloud
write_ply_color: write colored point cloud data to a PLY file using class labels and a colormap
rotate_point_cloud: rotate a point cloud around the Z axis by a random or given rotation matrix
